Population.evidence_source: This analysis draws upon 17 in-depth, semi-structured interviews with adult LGBT participants who reported having attempted suicide as young people. ... To be eligible for this study, participants needed to self-identify as LGB or T, be over 18 years of age, and at least 6 months had passed since their last suicide attempt which was judged to be life threatening (whether they had intended to die or not).

Type.evidence_source: The data-set for this analysis forms part of a larger study supported by the Big Lottery Fund. ... Participants were recruited as part of the first qualitative stage of our national study (Nodin et al., 2015)
